summary: Applied spec repairs for non-mutating bulk planning, disabled-package behavior, and JSON prompt stream.

items.title: Bulk candidate planning lacks a non-mutating integration point
items.rationale: Specified a non-mutating bulk plan phase and separate apply phase, and updated task notes so implementation cannot use the mutating update helper before confirmation.
items.evidence: spec.json constraints[5], overview.data_flow[0], overview.decisions[2], requirements R1/R2, AC1/AC2, and T-1/T-2 now require non-mutating planning before confirmation.

items.title: Scope conflicts with existing disabled-package behavior
items.rationale: Clarified that bulk update candidates are enabled installed packages only, preserving the existing `enabled !== false` behavior.
items.evidence: spec.json scope.in, constraints, overview.decisions, requirements R1/R2/R5/R7, AC1/AC8, clarifications, and task notes now state disabled packages are excluded.

items.title: JSON-mode confirmation stream is unspecified
items.rationale: Specified that prompts and refusal/status text go to stderr in JSON mode so stdout remains parseable JSON.
items.evidence: spec.json constraints, overview.decisions, AC9, clarifications, and T-2 acceptance/implementation notes now define the JSON stream contract.
